title: Inter: Bastoni's thigh scans before Genoa, Augusto to the back three
caption:
Inter say scans on Alessandro Bastoni found soreness in the quadriceps of his left thigh, with no return date, per Inter.it. Corriere dello Sport reports Carlos Augusto moves into the back three with Dimarco on the left, the setup that finished against Stuttgart. Inter host Genoa tonight at 2:45 PM ET. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
